(248590) 2006 CS
is an
asteroid
, classified as a
near-Earth object
of the
Apollo group
and probably a dormant
Jupiter family comet
.
[
2
]
It was discovered on 1 February 2006 by the
Siding Spring Survey
.
[
1
]
The object has been suggested to be the progenitor body of the β Tucanids or δ Mensids meteor showers, being, according to Diego Janches
et al
, a better candidate than the previously suggested comet C/1976 D1 (Bradfield). They also suggest the two showers are actually one and the same.
[
3
]
The meteor shower produced outbursts in 2020 and 2024.

2
